schema_file: question_schema_v7_file layer with locators stimuli rubric and provenance.json
procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (57 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 2 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side: q16 is a match table whose 5 rows print labels 17-21 (not questions, prompt §1a) -> labels 17-20 recorded as gaps; the one-mark section restarts at label 21 (q021). 60 questions. Answer side: 1-15, match rows 17-21, 22-63; keys 22-33 run +1 ahead (answer q021-q032, left EMPTY with 'shifted numbering — see key N', 12 questions), q033 no key, 34-63 aligned; q64 (draw) no key. Difficulty per question: easy 39, average 7, difficult 14, untagged 0.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 20 (heading, LO) 21-24; A pdf 126 (heading, keys 1-13) 127-129.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-10; s3 T/F q11-15; s4 '16. Match the following and write.(Easy)' q16 (rows labelled 17-21 + column B A)-E)); s5 one mark q21-35 vsa; s6 two marks q36-45 sa; s7 three marks q46-55 sa; s8 four marks q56-64 la.

NUMBERING: see reports/class-4-evs/evs-4-05_numbering_analysis.md. q021-q032 EMPTY + 'shifted numbering — see key N' (N = label+1); q033 'no answer printed'; q034 'displacement boundary' with its by-number key.
q11 label printed '11..' -> the extra '.' not stored. T/F answer-space underscores removed from text, kept in text_as_printed. q13 'cube' (for cubit) kept as printed.

q56, q57 'complete the table' stems stored with the printed table rows (cells ' | ', an unprinted cell left empty, read from the pdf 24 render); keys printed as tables (pdf 128) -> one solution_step per printed row incl. the header row (v2 §7). The keys also change given cells (q57 Rose 'Round' vs stem 'Spherical', Hibiscus 'Bell-like' vs 'Pooled') — stored as printed.
q57 prints its difficulty tag as '(hard)' -> difficulty 'difficult', difficulty_as_printed 'hard' (v2 §6 word map hard = difficult). Section-heading tags '(Easy)' on s1, s2, s3, s5.

q63 key: heading line 'Flowers are used:' + 4 bullets -> heading kept in answer.value, not a step (addendum §5.2). q50 poem key printed inline with ' / ' separators, stored verbatim. Prose keys wrapped over 2 lines joined (q50, q58, q59, q60, q62).
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_05.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
